notes: Exactly 12 evaluation questions for the complete 6-page Q1 FY2027 Infosys PDF.

The questions were selected across the full document, including ratio analysis, consolidated income statement, balance sheet data, shareholder information, market trading activity, investor complaints, legal proceedings and ADS information.
Questions intentionally cover direct facts, year-over-year comparisons, arithmetic comparisons, margins, operational metrics, balance-sheet movement and shareholder/market data.
relevant_pages uses the PDF page numbers where the source evidence appears.
Expected answers are grounded in the supplied PDF and do not use outside information.

questions.question: What were Infosys' consolidated revenues for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, and how did they compare with the quarter ended June 30, 2025?
questions.expected_answer: Revenue was ₹48,211 crore in Q1 FY2027, compared with ₹42,279 crore in Q1 FY2026, representing 14.0% growth.
questions.evidence: Page 3 Statement of comprehensive income reports revenues of ₹48,211 crore for the three months ended June 30, 2026 versus ₹42,279 crore for the comparable 2025 quarter, with 14.0% growth.

questions.question: What were Infosys' operating profit and net profit after non-controlling interest for Q1 FY2027, and what were their year-over-year growth rates?
questions.expected_answer: Operating profit was ₹10,163 crore, up 15.4% year over year. Net profit after non-controlling interest was ₹7,769 crore, up 12.2%.
questions.evidence: Page 3 reports operating profit of ₹10,163 crore with 15.4% growth and net profit after non-controlling interest of ₹7,769 crore with 12.2% growth.

questions.question: How did Infosys' cost of sales and gross profit change in Q1 FY2027 compared with Q1 FY2026?
questions.expected_answer: Cost of sales increased from ₹29,224 crore to ₹33,033 crore, a 13.0% increase. Gross profit increased from ₹13,055 crore to ₹15,178 crore, a 16.3% increase.
questions.evidence: Page 3 gives the Q1 FY2027 and Q1 FY2026 cost of sales and gross profit figures and their reported growth rates.

questions.question: Which operating expense grew faster in Q1 FY2027: selling and marketing expenses or administrative expenses, and what were their respective growth rates?
questions.expected_answer: Administrative expenses grew faster. Selling and marketing expenses increased 16.3%, while administrative expenses increased 19.7%.
questions.evidence: Page 3 reports 16.3% growth in selling and marketing expenses and 19.7% growth in administrative expenses.

questions.question: What were Infosys' basic and diluted EPS in Q1 FY2027, and what was the year-over-year growth for each?
questions.expected_answer: Basic EPS was ₹19.19 and diluted EPS was ₹19.17. Both increased 14.9% year over year.
questions.evidence: Page 3 reports basic EPS of ₹19.19 and diluted EPS of ₹19.17 for Q1 FY2027, each showing 14.9% growth.

questions.question: What were Infosys' total assets, total liabilities and total equity as of June 30, 2026?
questions.expected_answer: Total assets were ₹1,54,858 crore, total liabilities were ₹63,302 crore, and total equity was ₹91,556 crore.
questions.evidence: Page 3 balance sheet data as of June 30, 2026 reports total assets of ₹1,54,858 crore, total liabilities of ₹63,302 crore and total equity of ₹91,556 crore.

questions.question: By how much did Infosys' trade receivables decrease between March 31, 2026 and June 30, 2026?
questions.expected_answer: Trade receivables decreased by ₹1,453 crore, from ₹35,234 crore on March 31, 2026 to ₹33,781 crore on June 30, 2026.
questions.evidence: Page 3 shows trade receivables of ₹35,234 crore as of March 31, 2026 and ₹33,781 crore as of June 30, 2026.

questions.question: What were Infosys' export revenue-to-revenue ratios in Q1 FY2027 and Q1 FY2026, and what was the change?
questions.expected_answer: Export revenue was 97.5% of revenue in Q1 FY2027 versus 97.1% in Q1 FY2026, an increase of 0.4 percentage points.
questions.evidence: Page 1 Ratio Analysis reports export revenue/revenue of 97.5% for the three months ended June 30, 2026 and 97.1% for the corresponding 2025 quarter.

questions.question: How did Infosys' operating profit margin and profit-after-tax margin change in Q1 FY2027 compared with Q1 FY2026?
questions.expected_answer: Operating profit/revenue increased from 20.8% to 21.1%, while profit after tax/revenue decreased from 16.4% to 16.1%.
questions.evidence: Page 1 Ratio Analysis reports operating profit/revenue of 21.1% versus 20.8% and PAT/revenue of 16.1% versus 16.4% for Q1 FY2027 versus Q1 FY2026.

questions.question: What were Infosys' return on equity, day's sales outstanding, and operating cash flow-to-revenue ratio for Q1 FY2027?
questions.expected_answer: Return on equity was 32.1%, day's sales outstanding was 63 days, and operating cash flows/revenue was 20.4%.
questions.evidence: Page 1 Ratio Analysis reports ROE of 32.1%, DSO of 63 days and operating cash flows/revenue of 20.4% for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

questions.question: What was the total volume of Infosys equity shares traded on BSE and NSE during Q1 FY2027, and how did the combined volume compare with Q1 FY2026 as a percentage of average outstanding shares?
questions.expected_answer: Total BSE and NSE volume was 947,265,811 shares. Volume traded as a percentage of average outstanding shares was 25.52% in Q1 FY2027 versus 14.02% in Q1 FY2026, an increase of 11.50 percentage points.
questions.evidence: Page 5 shareholder information reports total BSE and NSE volume of 94,72,65,811 shares and volume traded/average outstanding shares of 25.52% for Q1 FY2027 versus 14.02% for Q1 FY2026.

questions.question: How many investor complaints were received, disposed of, and left unresolved at the end of Q1 FY2027, and what was the corresponding unresolved figure in Q1 FY2026?
questions.expected_answer: In Q1 FY2027, 31 complaints were received, 32 were disposed of, and 0 remained unresolved at quarter-end. In Q1 FY2026, 20 were received, 20 were disposed of, and 1 remained unresolved.
questions.evidence: Page 5 shows the dividend/annual report related/others complaint figures: Q1 FY2027 began with 1 pending, received 31, disposed 32 and ended with 0 unresolved; Q1 FY2026 began with 1 pending, received 20, disposed 20 and ended with 1 unresolved.
